headlines.title: Missouri Supreme Court rules new GOP-drawn map can’t be used for November elections
headlines.description: The court said a referendum seeking to put the map up for a vote must be placed on the ballot, meaning the state’s elections this fall will take place under its old congressional lines.

headlines.title: DOJ asks Supreme Court to allow Trump’s USPS action on mail-in ballots to proceed ahead of midterm elections
headlines.description: The appeal came shortly before a federal judge was set to decide whether to issue an injunction blocking requirements dictating how mail-in ballots are sent.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy’s defense attorney blames single juror for deadlock
headlines.description: The judge refused the defense lawyer’s request to remove a juror who he said “refuses to listen to the law” on reasonable doubt. NBC News’ Emilie Ikeda reports.

headlines.title: The unspoken testimony in the Lindsay Clancy trial
headlines.description: Dozens of witnesses were called over three weeks in the murder trial of Lindsay Clancy to testify about what led up to and followed the killing of her three young children. But one person who didn’t take the stand was Clancy herself. Both the prosecution and defense, however, read extensively from Clancy’s diary entries from the months leading up to the killings in a coastal Massachusetts town in 2023. Misty Marris breaks down what each side read from the diaries, and what they suggested her

headlines.title: What the jury must consider while deciding Lindsay Clancy's fate
headlines.description: As the jury considers the arguments presented by the prosecution and defense in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial, NBC News legal analyst Misty Marris and correspondent Steven Romo break down the instructions the 9 women and 3 men were given before heading into deliberations.

headlines.title: What is the Tuey-Rodriguez instruction the judge gave in the Lindsey Clancy trial?
headlines.description: Jurors in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial told the judge on Wednesday they were deadlocked for a second time, a day after they issued a first deadlock note to the judge. NBC News’ Laura Jarrett and Misty Marris explain the significance of the Tuey-Rodriguez instruction the judge gave the jury and why this next round of deliberation is crucial to the trial.

headlines.title: Gloria Steinem, feminist trailblazer, dies at 92
headlines.description: NBC News’ Anne Thompson reports on the life and legacy of Gloria Steinem, the women’s rights leader who spent more than half a century fighting for equality.

headlines.title: Feds charge ICE officer with lying to investigators in the shooting of a Venezuelan immigrant
headlines.description: A federal grand jury returned an indictment against Christian Castro in the January shooting that left Julio Cesar Sosa Celis with a gunshot wound in one of his legs.

headlines.title: OpenAI releases new model that it says triggered internal security measures
headlines.description: The AI giant says its model better follows user intent and crosses a frontier for cybersecurity capabilities, and could be artificial general intelligence.

headlines.title: Fox News parts ways with Maria Bartiromo
headlines.description: Fox News has parted ways with longtime anchor Maria Bartiromo, a vocal defender of President Donald Trump who hosted several financial news shows.

headlines.title: Colin Kaepernick is done with the NFL. He isn’t done fighting.
headlines.description: Ten years after taking a knee to stand against racism and police brutality at great cost to his career and finances, Colin Kaepernick is back in the spotlight.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.
